# Tesla’s Cybercab is about to launch — and we don’t get it

Avatar for Fred Lambert  Fred Lambert | Aug 17 2026 - 6:24 pm PT

5 Comments

Tesla Cybercab hero 

Tesla has told employees it is preparing a public launch of the Cybercab in Austin as soon as this month, according to a report from The Information. [...] Tesla’s Robotaxi account is already promoting a “Cybercab launch event,” running a promotion through August 23 that enters riders into a draw to attend it: “More rides = better odds.”
